scope: Existing checkpoint tensor statistics and analytical dependency arithmetic only. No model forward, gradient, optimizer update, inference benchmark, audio generation or checkpoint modification.

teacher_source.verification: sha256sum verified during this read-only audit before inspecting full source

layer_scales.interpretation: The residual branch multipliers have moved substantially from initialization; they are not still near 1e-6. Coefficient magnitudes do not measure the effective receptive field or each branch contribution on real audio.

adapter.phase_order: weight.reshape(64,4,64)[:,phase,:], matching [channel,phase] output ordering in model._phase_frames
adapter.precision: Float64 SVD of saved FP32 weights; torch.linalg.matrix_rank with default Float64 threshold
adapter.interpretation: Combined adapter retains full column rank and is substantially better conditioned than individual phase matrices. At phase zero causal layers cannot access phases 1-3 from the current latent. Poor single-phase conditioning is a candidate optimization difficulty, not a proven information loss or measured causal explanation; latent covariance and downstream mappings were not probed.

implementation.scored_mask: Complete scored latents only; context, right padding and partially valid final latents excluded from statistic estimation.

normalization.interpretation: No near-zero variance or numerical explosion is evident in these buffers. After freezing, training and evaluation share fixed statistics and affine parameters remain trainable. The planned fixed-weight sequential calibration of the two sites was not performed by this freeze-at-200 implementation; its impact on quality is unproven.

teacher.exact_backward_dependency: q = output_sample_index - 6; for r in [2,2,2,5,6,8]: q = floor((q - 78) / r) - 1; earliest_latent = q - 6. Latest latent = floor(output_sample_index / 1920).
teacher.qualification: Analytical structural support of the pinned convolution graph, away from true utterance startup. Does not estimate learned effective receptive field or include encoder history.

student.latent_phase_formula: internal t = 4*n+p, 0<=p<4; earliest latent = floor((t-116)/4) = n-29; latest latent = n.
student.qualification: Maximum graph support with fixed normalization. Four adapter phases do not add new input information or reduce external 40 ms latent arrival granularity.

receptive_field.interpretation: The actual 29-latent training context covers the student and exceeds teacher decoder support. Insufficient nominal history is not supported as the cause of current reconstruction errors.

synthesis_qualifications: The teacher contains 18 Snake residual units across progressively faster grids and a final sample-rate convolution plus tanh. The student instead has 10 low-rate GELU ConvNeXt blocks, kernel-3 PReLU head, bias-free 2048-to-480 projection and chronological flattening.

Released Supertonic 3 also uses GELU and PReLU; this is not evidence of a missing Supertonic Snake activation. Its native 24-channel ~86.13 Hz latent space differs from the frozen 64-channel 25 Hz AudioVAE2 space.

100 Hz hidden processing does not impose a 50 Hz audio bandwidth cap: the 2048-to-480 matrix can have rank 480 and produce arbitrary 480-sample blocks. Learning phase continuity and fine waveform detail is the concern.

An absent final bias does not guarantee silence. Upstream biases or normalization offsets can project to a repeated 480-sample template (100 Hz repetition); four phase-specific adapter biases can also induce a 1920-sample/25 Hz pattern. This is a possible mechanism, not a causal attribution from this static audit.
Student replicate startup padding differs from teacher zero padding. Saved earlier beginning/interior metrics did not localize the broad failure to crop starts.
The teacher condition is fixed to 48 kHz, so omission of a variable sample-rate embedding is not loss of changing conditioning information in this single-rate student.
